how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:druid-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:26:obj:0: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:26:details:0: ⟦1⟧, I have been following your progress with much delight. You are most assuredly developing yourself into a valued protector of nature.
rows.quest:26:details:1: BThe time has come for you to learn more about one of the various animal aspects that Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to change into - one that affords you command and mastery of the water. For this, you must travel to the village of Nighthaven in ⟦E1⟧ and speak with Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle there. He will guide you further.
rows.quest:26:completion:0: Salutations, young ⟦2⟧; the time has come for you to know our aquatic form. It is one that lets you move freely and indefinitely through water. You will find this aspect a useful tool and a blessing... but it is one that must be earned before it is mastered.
rows.quest:26:completion:1: BYou will face two trials to overcome. The first will test your ability to work in water under pressure. The second will test your resolve to understand the aspects of the form itself.
rows.quest:26:completion:2: BStand ready, as the time of testing is now upon us.

rows.quest:28:obj:0: Find a Shrine Bauble in Lake ⟦E2⟧'ara, and take it to the Shrine of Remulos in northwestern ⟦E1⟧. Once there, use the Shrine Bauble.
rows.quest:28:obj:1: BYou must speak with Tajarri at the shrine afterwards in order to complete the trial.
rows.quest:28:details:0: For your first trial, search the depths of Lake ⟦E2⟧'ara to locate a Shrine Bauble. It decays rapidly, so proceed with it to the Shrine of Remulos post haste. Use the bauble at the shrine, and then speak with Tajarri there; she is one of ⟦E1⟧'s most trusted wardens.
rows.quest:28:details:1: BYou only have a set amount of time to complete the task, and you may be competing against other druids searching for baubles themselves. Mental and physical dexterity will be critical to your success.
rows.quest:28:completion:0: Well now. It looks like yet another ⟦6⟧ has successfully completed the Trial of the Lake! Well done, my young friend - well done.
rows.quest:28:completion:1: BAs I've said, my name is Tajarri. It is my duty and my privilege to serve as a warden for ⟦E1⟧, and specifically this shrine. Keeper Remulos guides the Cenarion Circle in preservation of nature and balance, and his shrine serves as a lasting tribute to such. By using the bauble here, it serves as a nod to the importance of this place within the Circle.

rows.quest:30:obj:0: Find the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility and the Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance. Speak with the residents of ⟦E1⟧ to learn clues as to where these items may be located.
rows.quest:30:obj:1: BForm the Pendant of the Sea Lion from the two pendant halves. You need to be in proximity of the Shrine of Remulos to do this.
rows.quest:30:obj:2: BBring the joined pendant to Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:30:details:0: For the second trial, you'll need the two halves that make the Pendant of the Sea Lion. One half draws power from the agility of the sea lion aspect, gliding through water; the other draws power from the incredible endurance of the sea lion aspect. Druids draw on both these traits equally to embody the aspect of their aquatic form.
rows.quest:30:details:1: BSpeak with the locals of ⟦E1⟧ to learn where the parts may lie, and bring both here to join them together. Once formed, take the pendant to Dendrite Starblaze.
rows.quest:30:completion:0: You've completed the Trial of the Sea Lion, ⟦9⟧ - congratulations.
rows.quest:30:completion:1: BEach task in acquiring the pendant shows that both agility and endurance are necessary to act in harmony with what you desire to do underwater. Neither can exist without the other, and both cannot be done without your willingness to embrace the aspect of the sea lion.
rows.quest:30:completion:2: BRemember these lessons well, and count on them once you have gained your aquatic form.
rows.quest:31:obj:0: Return to ⟦E3⟧ and show Turak Runetotem the Pendant of the Sea Lion.
rows.quest:31:details:0: You have completed the necessary lessons all young druids are taught before they can adopt an aquatic aspect. Go now back to your trainer, Turak Runetotem, in ⟦E3⟧. Show him your pendant and prove to him you are ready to learn what he has to teach you. He will complete your training, allowing you to become one with the water.
rows.quest:31:details:1: BGoodbye, young druid. We shall speak again.
rows.quest:31:completion:0: Very impressive, ⟦10⟧. Your ancestors would be pleased with your progress! You're ready to learn your aquatic form, and it is my pleasure to teach it to you.
rows.quest:31:completion:1: BAlso, in recognition of your achievement during the two trials, I give you this item. I hope you'll find it to be a welcome addition to your gear as a protector of nature and a keeper of the balance.

rows.quest:3094:obj:0: Read the Verdant Note and speak to Gart Mistrunner in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:3094:details:0: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, ⟦12⟧. I believe she was sent by the druid trainer Gart. If this note is from Gart, I wouldn't take long in reading its contents.⟦13⟧
rows.quest:3094:completion:0: Though we share a common bond, do not expect much welcome from the night elves. Their pride still limits their sight, but that is none of our concern. The teachings of the Earthmother are all you must concern yourself with, and I will teach you what I know as you grow in wisdom.
rows.quest:3094:completion:1: BReturn to me often, ⟦14⟧. You will find that the Earthmother grants incredible abilities to those who are most dedicated.
rows.quest:3120:obj:0: Read the Verdant Sigil and speak to Mardant Strongoak, in the tree Aldrassil in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:3120:details:0: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our druid trainer, Mardant. It seems Mardant would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to him afterwards.
rows.quest:3120:completion:0: I will be your mentor and guide for now. It is my duty to teach you how to interpret not only what the spirits communicate to us, but also the complexities and secrets of the Emerald Dream.
rows.quest:3120:completion:1: BAs you learn and grow in power, you will learn more of our sleeping trance. But until then, return to me as often as you like and I will teach you what I can in the ways of our kind.

rows.quest:5921:obj:0: Use the spell "Teleport: ⟦E1⟧" to travel to ⟦E1⟧. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
rows.quest:5921:details:0: All druids are welcome in the sacred lands of ⟦E1⟧, regardless of the current tensions in the Cenarion Circle between Arch ⟦E7⟧ Staghelm and Keeper Remulos - ⟦E1⟧'s guardian. Now that you're learning the ways of the ⟦E8⟧, I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek ⟦E1⟧'s knowledge or solace.
rows.quest:5921:details:1: BAs for your first lesson, travel to ⟦E1⟧ and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.
rows.quest:5921:completion:0: "And so it begins. Father Cenarius. And so it begins."
rows.quest:5921:completion:1: BDendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him. A slight aura of power falls over him.
rows.quest:5921:completion:2: B"The first perspective of nature you must adapt to is that of the bear. I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but it is you that must embrace it and propagate it - now and forever!"
rows.quest:5922:obj:0: Use the spell "Teleport: ⟦E1⟧" to travel to ⟦E1⟧. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

rows.quest:5923:obj:0: Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave, ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:5923:details:1: BIt has come to my attention that Mathrengyl Bearwalker has put out word that he wishes to speak with you. It seems that your training as a druid is about to take on a new life, and he will be training you personally. Mathrengyl is the direct assistant to the Arch ⟦E7⟧ himself, and is one of the most sage and august druids you'll find in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:5923:details:2: BHe is located in the Cenarion Enclave of ⟦E6⟧, on the second floor of Fandral Staghelm's tree.
rows.quest:5923:completion:0: I am glad you found your way here today. young ⟦16⟧. The time has come for you to take a large step into a much larger world.
rows.quest:5923:completion:1: BInside each of Cenarius' children is the call to serve nature. Animals and plants are our friends as well as our charges. We choose to devote our lives as preservers of balance for their sakes as well as our own. Your first step into this world will be to learn of the ways of the bear, and to learn strength of body and heart.

rows.quest:5929:obj:0: Seek out the Great Bear Spirit in northwestern ⟦E1⟧ and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the bear. When finished, return to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven, ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5929:details:0: In the northwest part of ⟦E1⟧ resides the home of a wise and noble being we call the Great Bear Spirit. For all druids, it has served as a tutor and mentor into the first true natural understanding of the bear. All druids at one point seek the spirit's wisdom, and you shall be no exception.
rows.quest:5929:details:1: BGo to the Great Bear Spirit now and learn what it will teach. When it is satisfied with you, return to me here in Nighthaven. We will then see if you have truly taken account of the lessons it teaches.
rows.quest:5929:completion:0: Dendrite makes another invisible gesture in the air above him as you approach. Another aura of power comes over him. and he smiles ever so slightly.
rows.quest:5929:completion:1: B"I sense wisdom in you, young one, that was not present when we first met. You gaze upon me with strength and knowing intent, though this intent is yet not focused. You will now learn to focus your strength and adopt the nature of the bear into your work."

rows.quest:5931:obj:0: Return to ⟦E6⟧ and speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave.
rows.quest:5931:details:0: The time has come for us to part ways, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me. Mathrengyl Bearwalker walks truly in balance with nature, even as he dwells precariously close to where the balance has faltered. Listen to his instructions, and you will soon complete your first lessons into your role as a protector of balance.
rows.quest:5931:details:1: BGo now, young one. We shall meet again.
rows.quest:5931:completion:0: Welcome back, ⟦22⟧. I sense that your first meeting with the Great Bear Spirit is the same as it is with all druids when they first start down the path of the ⟦E8⟧... a little bewildering, but very intense. I know it was that way with me.
rows.quest:5931:completion:1: BThe Great Bear Spirit has been a part of ⟦E10⟧ as long as ⟦E10⟧ has existed in the heavens. We have come to rely on its wisdom and its power to fuel our purpose. Now, the time has now come for your first test of this purpose. Listen closely...
rows.quest:5932:obj:0: Return to ⟦E3⟧ and speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise.
rows.quest:5932:details:0: The time has come for us to part ways, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me. Though the tauren are thought to be young in the ways of Cenarius, Turak Runetotem walks with much balance in the presence of nature. Listen to his instructions, and you will soon complete your first lessons into your role as a protector of balance.
rows.quest:5932:details:1: BGo now, young one. We shall meet again.
rows.quest:5932:completion:0: Welcome back, ⟦23⟧. I sense that your first meeting with the Great Bear Spirit is the same as it is with all druids when they first start down the path of the ⟦E8⟧... a little bewildering, but very intense. I know it was that way with me.
rows.quest:5932:completion:1: BThe Great Bear Spirit has been a part of ⟦E10⟧ as long as ⟦E10⟧ has existed in the heavens. We tauren listen closely to such spirits, and we all prosper from its purpose. Now, the time has now come for your first test of this purpose. Listen closely...
rows.quest:6001:obj:0: Use the Cenarion Moondust on the Moonkin Stone of Auberdine to bring forth Lunaclaw. From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.
rows.quest:6001:obj:1: BSpeak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in ⟦E6⟧ when you are done.
rows.quest:6001:details:0: Directly east of Auberdine lay many moonkin caves. The one closest to Auberdine has a Moonkin Stone inside it. Lunaclaw, the defender of the stone, will face you only when Cenarion Moondust is applied to it. Lunaclaw possesses within it a strength that you must use as one of the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:6001:details:1: BYou've earned the right to use this Cenarion Moondust, ⟦24⟧... now show me that you've earned the right to possess the strength of body and the strength of heart needed as a druid!
rows.quest:6001:completion:0: You have finally taken your large step into a much larger world, ⟦25⟧. I sense the teaching of the Great Bear Spirit within you, and I sense that you have received the strength that Lunaclaw possessed.
rows.quest:6001:completion:1: BThere are no further obstacles in your way... let me now teach you what it means to be a ⟦E7⟧ of the ⟦E8⟧!
rows.quest:6002:obj:0: Use the Cenarion Lunardust on the Moonkin Stone between ⟦E11⟧ and the ⟦E12⟧ to bring forth Lunaclaw. From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.
rows.quest:6002:obj:1: BSpeak with Turak Runetotem in ⟦E3⟧ when you are done.
rows.quest:6002:details:0: On land west of Taurajo in the ⟦E12⟧ - just before it turns into ⟦E11⟧ - lies a Moonkin Stone. The moonkin are special beasts, not native to these parts. Lunaclaw, the stone's defender, will face you when Cenarion Lunardust is applied to it. Lunaclaw possesses within it a strength that you must use as one of the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:6002:details:1: BYou've earned the right to use this Cenarion Lunardust, ⟦26⟧... now show me that you've earned the right to possess the strength of body and the strength of heart needed as a druid!

rows.quest:6121:details:0: You're now ready to learn about poison and the power we as druids have over it, ⟦28⟧. Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to purge even the most foul of poisons with but a mere incantation. This gift is not to be taken lightly... and to ensure you learn this lesson, you'll work to address the effects of poisonings as a layman would.
rows.quest:6121:details:1: BTravel to ⟦E1⟧ and speak with Dendrite Starblaze; he awaits your arrival to begin your lesson.
rows.quest:6121:completion:0: Greetings young ⟦29⟧, I'm glad to see you ready and eager to learn about the curing of poisons.
rows.quest:6121:completion:1: BWhile most druids in the past were put through pre-planned trials, your work will involve no such thing. There has been a rash of animal poisonings in Auberdine, and the village there has been unable to cure it. To that end, a representative there has asked ⟦E1⟧ for aid and we are sending you there to aid them. This is no exercise - the work you'll do is quite real. Bear this in mind.
rows.quest:6122:obj:0: Use the Empty ⟦E14⟧ Sampler to draw a sample of water from the mouth of the cave by the falls.
rows.quest:6122:obj:1: BDeliver the Filled ⟦E14⟧ Sampler to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine, ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:6122:details:0: The ⟦E14⟧ in ⟦E15⟧ serves as the principal source of drinking water for the region, and now I suspect it is the principal source of the poison that is harming the local fauna - deer specifically. Use this sampler to draw some water from the mouth of the cave; be careful, as dangerous naga now reside in a cave by the falls.
rows.quest:6122:details:1: BOnce filled, deliver it to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine. She is the one that requested our aid, and you will work with her to address this malady.
rows.quest:6122:completion:0: By ⟦E2⟧, this water is disgusting! No wonder the deer are sick.
rows.quest:6122:completion:1: BSomething is polluting the water, and in turn corrupting ⟦E15⟧'s entire water table. Sick deer have been seen all over area, and not just by the river. While this water is most likely a primary source of the sickness spreading, there's something else at work here.
rows.quest:6122:completion:2: BThis water, believe it or not, will help us formulate a cure. While I research this water, I have need of some items to formulate a cure...
rows.quest:6123:obj:0: Bring 5 Earthroot and 12 Lunar Funguses to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine so she may make a curative salve.
rows.quest:6123:details:0: The water will serve as the base of the curative salve I'll make for the deer. For curative properties, I need some earthroot. Herbalists know how to find it, so if we're unlucky and you aren't one then you'll need to find one to help us out.
rows.quest:6123:details:1: BFinally for potency, I need some lunar fungus. Finding lunar fungal blooms is easy enough; they're all over the place in caves just to the east of here. Moonkin reside in the caves and they're irritable as of late, so be careful.
rows.quest:6123:completion:0: This is good, ⟦30⟧, so much so that it should be enough to make some ample doses of the salve - at least enough to start to make a difference.
rows.quest:6123:completion:1: BMaking a cure for poisons can be quite difficult at times because each one often requires a very specific antidote to counteract it. Imagine being able to cure a poison at will without having to worry about the exact ingredients of what the antidote must be!
rows.quest:6123:completion:2: BNow, let me get to work on this!
rows.quest:6124:obj:0: Use the Curative Animal Salve on 10 Sickly Deer that are located throughout ⟦E15⟧; doing so should cure them. rows.quest:6124:details:0: The amount of salve made out of the reagents you brought me is good enough for ten doses, ⟦31⟧. rows.quest:6124:details:1: BDendrite Starblaze in ⟦E1⟧ will want to talk to you when you're done, I'm sure. Please extend Auberdine's thanks to the Cenarion Circle there... and let me say thanks to you directly for the help you've given!
rows.quest:6124:completion:0: You have done well in tending to the sickly deer of ⟦E15⟧; they are unwitting victims of a greater taint and corruption that is spreading all throughout the land. I hope you will not be one to put blinders on about what facts stare you in the face, ⟦32⟧.
rows.quest:6124:completion:1: BRegardless, you've proven your worth as a friend of nature and the Circle - take this as a symbol of such.

rows.quest:6125:details:0: You've learned what it means to cure poison without the benefit of spiritual aid. Remember what others must endure in fighting poisonous afflictions as you soon embrace your newfound power over poison.
rows.quest:6125:details:1: BYou should now return to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in ⟦E6⟧, ⟦33⟧. He, no doubt, has a very important spell to teach you now that the student understands the lesson given unto ⟦34⟧.
rows.quest:6125:details:2: BFarewell, young druid. We shall speak again.
rows.quest:6125:completion:0: Welcome back - I've been following your progress on this lesson since you left, and I must admit I was surprised to learn about the situation in Auberdine. This does bear some further investigation, as the introduction of such poisons into the environment is most upsetting to the balance.
rows.quest:6125:completion:1: BYou handled yourself with grace under pressure. For that, I can find no better way to reward you than with permanent power over poison. Use it well, ⟦35⟧... use it well.

rows.quest:9051:obj:0: Stab a Devilsaur with the Devilsaur Barb. Return to Torwa Pathfinder in ⟦E18⟧ when you have completed this task.
rows.quest:9051:details:0: The toxin you helped me create is for a special purpose. The great devilsaurs of the crater make it dangerous to hunt and difficult for me to survive. Even if I possessed the necessary strength, killing a devilsaur simply allows another to move into its territory.
rows.quest:9051:details:1: BTake this poisoned barb and stab it deep into a living devilsaur. The toxin should pacify the creature, though I do not know how quickly...
rows.quest:9051:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦45⟧. You are brave and wise.
rows.quest:9051:completion:1: BTell me, how did the devilsaur react to the toxin?
rows.quest:9052:obj:0: Collect 8 Bloodcap and 8 Gorishi Stings, and return to Torwa Pathfinder in ⟦E18⟧.
rows.quest:9052:details:0: I would ask you to help me create a toxin of sorts, to pacify a great creature living here in the crater. It is not deadly, and only the keen eyes of a ⟦46⟧ can hope to collect the ingredients.
rows.quest:9052:details:1: BYou can find the bloodcap ⟦E19⟧ growing within the bloodpetal sprouts all across the crater. Gorishi stings are from the insects inside and around the Slithering Scar, located in the southern part of the crater.
rows.quest:9052:completion:1: BWith the Un'Goro soil I have collected, the toxin is easily concocted...
rows.quest:9053:obj:0: Retrieve a Putrid Vine from the guardian at the bottom of the Sunken Temple and return to Torwa Pathfinder.
rows.quest:9053:details:0: It is as I feared -- the toxin is simply too weak for such a powerful creature.
rows.quest:9053:details:1: BIf we are to create a toxin of high enough potency, you must venture to the bottom of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, unlock the secrets of the altar and recover a putrid vine from the guardian there. The temple is dangerous, and it would behoove you to bring friends.
rows.quest:9053:details:2: BReturn to me when this is done.
rows.quest:9053:completion:0: At last, the toxin can be created in full. I dare not require you to inflict it upon the creature again, as I have asked too much already.
rows.quest:9053:completion:1: BYou have my thanks and respect. May you be well in your travels, ⟦47⟧.
rows.quest:9063:details:0: A hunter by the name of Torwa Pathfinder has requested the help of a druid. He said only we would possess the necessary skills and respect for nature to help him.
rows.quest:9063:details:1: BThere is a road that connects the ⟦E18⟧ and the desert of ⟦E20⟧. As that road enters the crater, you will find Torwa close by.
rows.quest:9063:completion:0: You have traveled far to meet with me, ⟦48⟧, and not a moment too soon.
